Name: (CP) Alpaca Facelift
Author: emjess
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]After much trials and tribulations I have converted [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37783]my sprites[/url] for [/color][color=#d4d4d8]birdb's [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]Alpacas[/url][color=#d4d4d8] to CP so my duckies can swim.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]They should select a random skin when you buy one, or you can use something like Livestock Bazaar to pick (one of each! one of each!)[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Pop in thee mods folder IFF you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]Alpacas[/url] installed![/color]

Looking for the AT version?: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37783]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37783[/url]
